component.name: LivePlayer
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.loading = m.top.findNode("loading") m.loadingLbl = m.top.findNode("loadingLbl") m.errorLbl = m.top.findNode("errorLbl")
m.nowPlaying = m.top.findNode("nowPlaying") m.npChannel = m.top.findNode("npChannel") m.npTitle = m.top.findNode("npTitle") m.npMeta = m.top.findNode("npMeta") m.npClock = m.top.findNode("npClock")
m.pager = m.top.findNode("pager") m.pagerNum = m.top.findNode("pagerNum") m.pagerOf = m.top.findNode("pagerOf")
m.drawer = m.top.findNode("drawer") m.drawerList = m.top.findNode("drawerList") m.drawerDate = m.top.findNode("drawerDate") m.drawerIn = m.top.findNode("drawerIn") m.drawerOut = m.top.findNode("drawerOut")
m.clockTimer = m.top.findNode("clockTimer") m.hideTimer = m.top.findNode("hideTimer")
m.drawerOpen = false m.overlayVisible = true m.currentTitle = "" m.currentDuration = 0
m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.clockTimer.observeField("fire", "onClockTick") m.hideTimer.observeField("fire", "onHideOverlay") m.drawerList.observeField("itemSelected", "onDrawerSelect")
m.clockTimer.control = "start" updateClock() showOverlay() end sub
sub onChannelChange() ch = m.top.channel if ch = invalid or ch.id = invalid then return closeDrawer() m.errorLbl.visible = false m.loadingLbl.text = "Tuning in to " + ch.name + "…" m.loading.visible = true populateDrawer() m.resolver = CreateObject("roSGNode", "StreamResolver") m.resolver.apiBase = m.top.apiBase m.resolver.channelId = ch.id m.resolver.observeField("result", "onStreamResolved") m.resolver.observeField("error", "onStreamError") m.resolver.control = "RUN" renderNowPlaying() showOverlay() end sub
sub onStreamResolved() r = m.resolver.result if r = invalid or r.stream_url = invalid then return m.currentTitle = r.title if r.duration <> invalid then m.currentDuration = r.duration else m.currentDuration = 0 renderNowPlaying()
ci = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") ci.url = r.stream_url ci.streamFormat = pickFormat(r.format) ci.title = r.title m.video.content = ci m.video.control = "play" end sub
function pickFormat(fmt as dynamic) as string if fmt = invalid then return "mp4" f = LCase(fmt) if f = "hls" then return "hls" if f = "dash" then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
function fmtDur(secs as integer) as string mm = Int(secs / 60) ss = secs - mm * 60 sss = ss.ToStr() if Len(sss) < 2 then sss = "0" + sss return mm.ToStr() + ":" + sss end function
sub onStreamError() m.loading.visible = false m.errorLbl.text = m.resolver.error m.errorLbl.visible = true end sub
sub onVideoState() state = m.video.state if state = "playing" m.loading.visible = false else if state = "error" m.errorLbl.text = "Playback error — advancing" m.errorLbl.visible = true m.loading.visible = false stepChannel(1) else if state = "finished" onChannelChange() end if end sub
' -------- Now Playing / Clock -------- sub renderNowPlaying() ch = m.top.channel if ch = invalid then return m.npChannel.text = UCase(ch.name) m.npTitle.text = m.currentTitle if m.currentDuration > 0 m.npMeta.text = "Duration: " + fmtDur(m.currentDuration) else m.npMeta.text = "Now playing" end if m.pagerNum.text = (m.top.currentIndex + 1).ToStr() list = m.top.channelList total = 1 if list <> invalid then total = list.Count() m.pagerOf.text = "of " + total.ToStr() end sub
sub updateClock() dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() hh = dt.GetHours() mm = dt.GetMinutes() suffix = " AM" if hh >= 12 then suffix = " PM" if hh = 0 then hh = 12 if hh > 12 then hh = hh - 12 mmStr = mm.ToStr() if Len(mmStr) < 2 then mmStr = "0" + mmStr m.npClock.text = hh.ToStr() + ":" + mmStr + suffix
dateStr = dt.AsDateString("short-date") m.drawerDate.text = "Playlist: " + dateStr end sub
sub onClockTick() updateClock() end sub
' -------- Overlay show/hide -------- sub showOverlay() m.nowPlaying.opacity = 1 m.pager.opacity = 1 m.overlayVisible = true m.hideTimer.control = "stop" m.hideTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onHideOverlay() if m.drawerOpen then return m.nowPlaying.opacity = 0 m.pager.opacity = 0 m.overlayVisible = false end sub
' -------- Drawer -------- sub populateDrawer() list = m.top.channelList if list = invalid then return content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") i = 0 for each ch in list it = content.createChild("ContentNode") it.title = ch.name vcount = 0 if ch.videos <> invalid then vcount = ch.videos.Count() it.description = vcount.ToStr() + " videos" it.shortDescriptionLine1 = (i + 1).ToStr() thumb = ch.thumbnail if thumb = invalid or thumb = "" then thumb = "pkg:/images/icon_side_hd.png" it.HDGRIDPOSTERURL = thumb i = i + 1 end for m.drawerList.content = content m.drawerList.jumpToItem = m.top.currentIndex end sub
sub openDrawer() if m.drawerOpen then return populateDrawer() m.drawerOpen = true m.drawerOut.control = "stop" m.drawerIn.control = "start" m.drawerList.setFocus(true) m.drawerList.jumpToItem = m.top.currentIndex showOverlay() end sub
sub closeDrawer() if not m.drawerOpen then return m.drawerOpen = false m.drawerIn.control = "stop" m.drawerOut.control = "start" m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onDrawerSelect() idx = m.drawerList.itemSelected list = m.top.channelList if list = invalid or idx < 0 or idx >= list.Count() then return m.top.currentIndex = idx ch = list[idx] m.top.channel = { id: ch.id, name: ch.name, thumbnail: ch.thumbnail } end sub
' -------- Channel up/down -------- sub stepChannel(delta as integer) list = m.top.channelList if list = invalid or list.Count() = 0 then return n = list.Count() idx = m.top.currentIndex + delta if idx < 0 then idx = n - 1 if idx >= n then idx = 0 m.top.currentIndex = idx ch = list[idx] m.top.channel = { id: ch.id, name: ch.name, thumbnail: ch.thumbnail } end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "back" if m.drawerOpen closeDrawer() return true end if m.video.control = "stop" m.top.closed = true return true end if
' If drawer is open, let the drawer list handle up/down/OK. if m.drawerOpen if key = "right" closeDrawer() return true end if return false end if
showOverlay()
if key = "left" openDrawer() return true end if if key = "up" or key = "channelup" stepChannel(-1) return true end if if key = "down" or key = "channeldown" stepChannel(1) return true end if if key = "OK" or key = "play" if m.video.state = "playing" m.video.control = "pause" else m.video.control = "resume" end if return true end if return false end function
